Validate Your AI Skills 
and Knowledge
ADVANCE YOUR KNOW-HOW WITH ISACA’S ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE FUNDAMENTALS CERTIFICATE
Earn your certificate and build toward ISACA’s Certified in Emerging Technology Certification.
Gain Foundational 
Understanding of 
AI with Artificial 
Intelligence 
Fundamentals
Artificial intelligence has acted as the main driver of 
emerging technologies like big data, robotics and IoT, 
and it will continue to act as a technological innovator for 
the foreseeable future—opening many career opportunities 
for professionals who understand how it impacts business 
and are versed in the technologies that drive this important 
emerging tech domain.
ISACA’s performance-based Artificial Intelligence Fundamentals 
Certified in Emerging Technology™ (CET) Certification Stack can  
enable you to:
	 Explain the characteristics of artificial intelligence and gain hands-on 
skills with machine learning and robotic process automation.
	 Define statistical sampling populations, methods, statistical modeling, 
regression and how they apply to AI.
	 Enhance your resume/CV strength and prominence to recruiters.
The Artificial Intelligence Fundamentals Certificate affirms your knowledge 
and skills in key concepts, standards and real-world applications of AI 
topics.
Ideal for entrants or practitioners in any field of information systems. 
The ever-increasing need for practitioners in artificial intelligence, 
machine learning and governance make the certificate relevant for:
	 Professionals seeking foundational knowledge in artificial intelligence 
topics and functions.
	 Technology professionals looking for hands-on skills in real world 
applications of artificial intelligence.
	 Entrants into the IT profession.
ISACA connects you to what’s next
Connecting nearly 170,000 professionals in over 180 countries, ISACA® is a 
global leader in certification, training and education. We provide knowledge, 
standards, networking, and career development for information systems audit, 
control, security, cybersecurity, risk, privacy and governance professionals.  
We advance and validate business-critical skills and knowledge.

Get the training and exam prep that works best for you.
ISACA offers a variety of training options and exam preparation that will 
hone your knowledge of this increasingly important field and ready you for 
the Artificial Intelligence Fundamentals Certificate Exam:
Online Course: This interactive, self-guided course was created by experts 
to guide you through lessons and hands-on tasks to prepare you for real 
world situations. 
Lab Package: If you don’t need the lessons or want to further supplement 
your education with hands-on tasks, the lab package provides hands-on 
training to get you more comfortable doing the work.
Study Guide: The study guide, available in print and digital form, will let you 
know what to expect from the exam, including sample questions to help  
you prepare.
2- or 4-day workshops available during ISACA events or as an 
on-site or virtual training course.
Learn more at  
https://www.isaca.org/credentialing/cet/artificial-intelligence-fundamentals-certificate
AFFIRM YOUR KNOWLEDGE–TAKE THE ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE 
FUNDAMENTALS CERTIFICATE EXAM AT YOUR CONVENIENCE
The Artificial Intelligence Fundamentals Exam tests for foundational 
knowledge and performance-based skills across two key areas:
	 AI Concepts
	 AI Implementation
Take the exam online at your convenience by scheduling a date and time 
that work for you.
Learn more at  
https://www.isaca.org/credentialing/cet/artificial-intelligence-fundamentals-certificate
For self-paced learning it is highly recommended that you purchase the 
online course, lab package and study guide to best prepare for the exam.
